caption: A blender with its button held down is plugged into a wall socket, and the blades start spinning.

sa.check: A blender with its button held down.
The blender is plugged into a wall socket.
The blades are still before the plug goes in, though the button is held.
The order is button held, plug in, blades spin.

pc.expect: The blades start at the moment the plug seats in the socket, and only then; holding the button alone does nothing while unplugged.
pc.fail: The blades spin before the plug reaches the socket; or the plug is in and the blades stay still to the end of the clip; or the blades start with the plug lying loose; or the blades spin only when the button is released.

pc.expect: Before the plug is in nothing in the jug moves; afterwards the blades run steadily while the button is held and do not stop, start or reverse on their own.
pc.fail: The blades stop and restart with the plug in and the button held; or the contents swirl before the plug is in; or the blades reverse; or the jug spins with the blades.

pc.expect: Any contents swirl round the jug in the blades' direction, climbing the walls and dipping at the centre.
pc.fail: The contents rise as a column; or swirl against the blades; or stay flat and still while the blades spin; or leap out of a closed jug.

pc.expect: The cord hangs slack from the plug to the blender and stays attached; the jug and blades stay rigid.
pc.fail: The cord stands rigid in the air or stretches like elastic; or the jug wobbles or bulges; or the blades flop like rubber.

pc.expect: One blender, one plug, one socket; the plug enters the socket rather than the wall; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The plug passes into the wall beside the socket; or a second plug or jug appears; or the hand passes through the blender; or the contents pass through the jug's walls.

pc.expect: The blender's colour, the jug and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The blender changes colour; or the jug changes shape; or the counter's contents rearrange.
